muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-sse-event-option-type=AdminEventOption
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Stream(ctx, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Stream declares its variadic with the renamed option type: the build only
// passes if generation produced AdminEventOption and its constructors.
func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(msg string, opts ...AdminEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("hello", WithEvent("admin"))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if want := "event: admin\ndata: hello\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
